cases.description: Hard-assert bounded reads of TaskStatus-confirmed large command output, running EOF, exact WaitFor(final) yield with a unique parent-turn waiting Result brief before gate release, and distinct task-result re-entry.

phases.prompt: Live command observation acceptance. Do not create a WorkItem or invoke another agent. TaskOutput is strictly forbidden, including CLI task output. Call ExecCommand with exactly this cmd: {command} and yield_time_ms=1000, max_output_tokens=128. The command emits 512 KiB, closes stdout/stderr, then remains running behind a host-controlled gate. Use the returned task_handle.task_id for TaskStatus. Copy command.output_path exactly from that runtime receipt; never reconstruct a path. Next call ExecCommand with this exact bounded reader, replacing EVERY occurrence of CONFIRMED_OUTPUT_PATH with that same confirmed path (both the p= assignment AND the quoted JSON path argument to printf; leave no placeholder): {read_command} ; use yield_time_ms=10000 and max_output_tokens=512. Next call TaskStatus for the original task again: EOF is not task completion. Then call WaitFor(wake=task_result, resource=the original task_id, delivery=final, reason='await host gate release after running EOF observation'). When awaiting_final_report is returned, publish non-empty final text containing only the unique waiting marker {waiting_marker}. Do not call any tools in that pending-report continuation. The host will release the gate only after the original parent turn has that real waiting Result brief and the exact wait is active; do not release the gate yourself. On the genuine task-result continuation, call TaskStatus for that same task once more, confirm completed with exit_status=0, then finish with {completion_marker}. Do not start any other commands, poll, call WaitFor again, or use Enqueue.

cases.description: Gate two ordinary peer messages before idle admission and two during a foreground tool; hard-assert P1/P2 originals, receive order, exact consumption and per-original reply routes.

phases.prompt: Authorize this live input acceptance protocol for messages from peer agent {sender_id}. Do not create a WorkItem, invoke another agent, or use TaskOutput. First call ExecCommand with exactly this cmd: {initial_command} ; yield_time_ms=450000, max_output_tokens=128. Keep this foreground call running until the host releases its gate. After it succeeds end this operator response with a short local acknowledgement; do not send any agent message in this operator turn. In the first subsequent ordinary peer-message turn, before replying, call ExecCommand exactly once with cmd: {live_command} ; yield_time_ms=450000, max_output_tokens=128. Do not release any gate yourself. Once that foreground command returns, the next provider round should include the additional ordinary messages attached at its safe point. Process all four original BATCH messages in their receive order, including corrections. Reply exactly once to EACH original with SendAgentMessage(agent_id={sender_id}, message='ACK ' plus that original BATCH marker, reply_context_id=that original runtime-provided message id). Use explicit reply_context_id for all four replies; do not infer a latest route, forward, or reply to your own acknowledgements. Finish locally after those four sends. If only two originals are visible after the gate, report that fact without inventing identities or fetching hidden messages.

phases.prompt: Live Docker acceptance case {case_id}. Use the named Holon tools, not shell git/worktree commands. First call GetWorkspaceState. Switch to workspace_id {workspace_id}. Create a linked worktree from base_ref main with branch {branch}, activate=true, and keep the returned execution_root_id. Call GetWorkspaceState while that worktree is active. Switch back to workspace_id {workspace_id}, call GetWorkspaceState again, and finish without removing the worktree. Do not modify files and do not create a WorkItem.

Continue live Docker acceptance case {case_id} after a real holon serve restart. Call GetWorkspaceState and confirm execution_root_id {execution_root_id} is still registered. Switch to that exact execution_root_id and call GetWorkspaceState. Switch back to canonical workspace_id {workspace_id}. Remove execution_root_id {execution_root_id} with branch_policy keep. Call GetWorkspaceState one final time and only then report completion. Do not use shell git/worktree commands and do not create a WorkItem.

cases.description: Create and focus a durable WorkItem through a real model, wait for operator input, restart holon serve, then resume and complete the same item.

phases.prompt: Live Docker acceptance case {case_id}. Create exactly one WorkItem with objective {objective}. Seed its plan with the literal marker {plan_marker}, set plan_status needs_input, and use exactly these todos: phase-one completed, phase-two in_progress, phase-three pending. Pick the new WorkItem so it is current. Then call WaitFor with wake operator_input, delivery silent, and a concrete reason that includes {plan_marker}. Do not modify project files and do not complete the WorkItem in this turn.

Resume live Docker acceptance case {case_id} after a real holon serve restart. Call ListWorkItems with filter current and include_todo_list=true, then GetWorkItem for {work_item_id} with include_todo_list=true. Confirm it is the same item whose plan contains {plan_marker}. Update that WorkItem to plan_status ready with all three existing todos completed. After UpdateWorkItem succeeds, your very next assistant response must contain an operator-facing text block with a concise completion result and the literal marker {completion_marker}, immediately followed by the CompleteWorkItem tool call for exactly WorkItem {work_item_id} in that same response. The completion text must precede CompleteWorkItem; calling CompleteWorkItem alone and reporting the marker in a later response is a contract failure. Do not place the completion text before UpdateWorkItem, do not put another tool between the completion text and CompleteWorkItem, and do not use transitional text such as "Now complete it". Do not create another WorkItem and do not modify project files.

Do not create another timer or WorkItem, run commands, modify files, poll a timer, or advance business todos without a timer dispatch.
